title: HPL3/Features Overview
wikitext:
{{todo|Add links for each feature}}

The HPL3 engine has a number of new features since the previous version, HPL2:

* Global sunlight with full shadow support
* Terrain generation with dynamic terrain LOD
* HDR lighting with filmic tone mapping
* The introduction of a custom shading language, HPSL
* Particle collision
* Depth of Field
* Coloured Specular
* Level Streaming (no loading screens between levels)
* Tessellation
* Fly Mode (an in-editor "fly" cam)
* Poser EditMode (an in-editor skeleton manipulator tool)
* Colour Picker
